annotations.title: Scan a Robinhood Chain contract now (members)

description: MEMBERS: read one Robinhood Chain contract FRESH, when rh_token_safety said found=false or the stored read is stale. Needs a PumpPill membership (Authorization: Bearer <claim>, from pumppill.org/premium) or one x402 payment per call (USDC on Base). Slow (10-20s cold; do not retry). Capped per member and per day; the answer reports the budget and a refusal names the cap and its reset (00:00 UTC). A read from the last few minutes is served from the store without spending. Not idempotent: each call may spend the cap.
name: rh_scan_now
